children: News Corp reported approximately $471.0 million of share repurchases to date under its $1 billion 2025 repurchase program.
Daily ASX notifications filed for Class A and Class B buy-backs under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
To date the company has purchased ~US$471,009,719 of Class A and B shares under the US$1bn authorization.
On 10/09/2026 the company bought back 11,786,414 securities for US$306,402,283.11 (Class A entry).
Also on 10/09/2026 purchases included 58,482 securities for US$1,712,399.75 (Class A entry second line) and other daily tallies across classes.
Repurchases conducted in USD, executed via broker Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC; program intended to enhance shareholder value.
